resources.string:
1. Tap Start Overlay to launch the floating button.
2. Switch to Soccer Stars — the overlay stays on screen.
3. Auto-detect wakes the engine when your turn begins.
4. Tap the floating button to show / hide the prediction line.
5. Touch-and-hold the button to drag it to any screen edge.

Grant SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW in Android Settings if prompted.

Soccer Stars Analyzer needs to capture your screen in order to detect the ball and active player, then compute the shot trajectory in real time.

• Frames are processed entirely on-device — no video is recorded and no images ever leave your phone.
• Capture runs only while the overlay is active.
• You can stop capture at any time by tapping Stop Overlay.

Tap Continue to grant access, or Skip Capture to run the overlay without trajectory tracking.
The \'Draw over other apps\' permission is required to show the prediction overlay.
Screen capture declined. The overlay will run, but trajectory tracking requires capture access.
